GOAL: Fix the design constraints for this ideation slot before proposing anything.
READ: the round brief (round-two context), the three earlier rounds' selected mechanisms, and issue-126 diagnostics summarised in the prompt. No filesystem access is available in this session (read permission denied, no shell), so the brief is the only evidence I can cite.
OBSERVED: (a) round-one coupling (TIGER_CURV-RESID-CONTRAST, a trainable encoder feeding a curved residual chain) collapsed twice to 1-2 prefixes per level because the curved assignment/reconstruction objective has its minimum at a zero residual at the origin; only the frozen-Stage-1-text variant trained, and it had no influence on the encoder; result test_recall@10 = 0.05439, gate 0.065. (b) capacity: level 1 uses all 256 codewords but level 2 and level 3 produce only 1769 and 2201 distinct prefixes over 24556 items, i.e. ~11 items share an identical 3-token SID - the SID is effectively 1-2 tokens deep for most items. (c) diagnostics: tree-ness premise is unavailable (degree-preserving rewiring is exactly as tree-like); curvature is a gauge (tangent rescaling by 1/sqrt(c) reproduces c=1 exactly); behaviour-CONTRAST metrics predict Recall, Euclidean controls match or beat hyperbolic forms; Gromov-delta and ancestor-depth weighting hurt; the radial term is group compactness and a radius permutation destroys the correlation.
REASONING: (1) any mechanism whose only geometry is a curvature-valued distance is gauge-trivial and cannot be the mechanism; the curved content must be an operation whose partition/aggregation is not a scaled Euclidean one (geodesic hyperplanes, gyrobarycentres, tangent compositions). (2) Collapse is avoidable only if the SID objective has no origin minimum: a cross-entropy over softmax(-d_P) has its MAXIMUM at the origin, not its minimum, whereas a residual/reconstruction objective has its minimum there. (3) The cheapest lever on recall left is prefix STRUCTURE (which items share a token, and how much SID capacity each behaviour region gets), because 2201 distinct triples for 24556 items means the model cannot separate items that differ in behaviour.
OPEN: pick one mechanism that (i) fixes the tree so collapse is structurally impossible, (ii) still sends gradient through the curved distance into the encoder, (iii) changes the prefix structure rather than the codebook positions.

GOAL: Decide the concrete mechanism and check it against the scope contract and the "no tuning / no ablation / derived constants only" policy.
OBSERVED / DECIDED: candidate = behtree-geocut-sid. Behaviour: directed consecutive-item transitions from the TRAIN split only -> symmetric normalised adjacency -> top-32 spectral embedding -> lift into the Poincare ball (c=1) with data-derived radii. Geometry: (i) the SID prefix tree is built by recursive MULTIWAY geodesic bisection, where a geodesic hyperplane is an affine hyperplane in the Klein chart (exact: Klein geodesics are affine), so the separator in the Poincare model is a sphere arc orthogonal to the boundary, not a flat plane; (ii) each node's anchor is the Karcher/gyro-barycentre of the behaviour ball coordinates of its members; (iii) assignment logits are exact Poincare distances to the anchors of the current parent's children.
Checks made: constants are derived, not swept: fanout bound b = 2^ceil(log2(N^(1/3))) = 32 from N=24556 and SID length 3; minimum node size 2; split acceptance is a 2-sigma one-sided test against the degree-preserving configuration-model null (which also answers diagnostic (a): I never assume tree-likeness, I calibrate to the rewired null); curvature is fixed at c=1 because it is a gauge, so no curvature is tuned.
Collapse check: anchors are FIXED at their gyrobarycentric values and never optimised, the loss is a hierarchical cross-entropy over softmax(-d_P) whose value is maximal (log k) at the origin, so shrinking the encoder output cannot lower the loss; gradients still reach the encoder through d_P(v_theta, a). This is the direct answer to round-one failure mode 2.
Prefix-structure check: ids are prefix-local child indices (0..b-1), so the token alphabet is reused under different parents and the used SID triples are exactly the tree leaves. That is the lever that can remove the ~11 items per identical triple without touching Stage3.
Policy check: one run, both-on only; behaviour-off and geometry-off switches exist; no weight to tune beyond a documented lambda=1 (reconstruction + hierarchical CE), no temperature sweep (tau=1 in c=1 units), no seed repetition.
OPEN: write the final block with equations, inputs/outputs, safeguards, cost at the frozen scale (4096 batch, 24 steps/epoch, 3000 epochs, baseline 0.145 s/epoch).
